name: Universal Solar, LLC
old_description: Stable electricity is one of the most recurrent problems of rural areas. At Universal Solar, LLC, we want to help our customers to enjoy power even when there are blackouts. We’re a solar company serving in Millersburg, PA, with almost a decade of experience in the industry. We take pride in providing our customers with energy-efficient solutions for their properties. If you’re looking for a trusted solar company in Millersburg, PA, you’re in the right place!
about:
Universal Solar, LLC is a solar installation and service company based in Millersburg, Pennsylvania. The company has been operating for nearly a decade, focusing on energy-efficient solutions for rural areas prone to blackouts. The business is operated by Elmer, who is frequently cited in customer reviews for his hands-on expertise and responsiveness.

The company designs and installs off-grid, grid-tied, and grid-interactive solar systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. Its service portfolio includes solar panel installation and repair, battery storage solutions, system maintenance and inspection, and well pump installations. Universal Solar serves a multi-county region in central and northeastern Pennsylvania, including Millersburg, Bloomsburg, Lewisburg, Williamsport, and Scranton.

Customers range from homeowners seeking backup power to businesses and industrial facilities aiming to lower energy costs. Commercial projects include roof-mounted arrays for businesses, while industrial installations target facility-scale energy production. The company also addresses agricultural and rural needs with off-grid systems and solar-powered well pumps.

Universal Solar was motivated by the vulnerability of the electrical grid and aims to help customers achieve energy independence. The company offers free estimates and financing options to reduce upfront costs.
